phase_name: Outer landrun hardening and git-remote pre-flight probe

objectives.description: Re-read confined() outer-landrun argv and rationale
Outer landrun layer inside systemd-run wrapper, preserving --no-share/guard structure
landrun absence non-fatal, loud warning, degraded proceed

approaches_tried.description: Manual /tmp end-to-end smoke test of the outer landrun wrap with a real landrun binary and stub lake/comparator
approaches_tried.reason: confirmed the outer landrun layer correctly execs the wrapped command and forwards named env vars once the test's own landrun stub was made exec-forwarding

deviations.reason: introducing the real outer landrun wrap broke every guard/verdict case because the suite's pre-existing write_noop_stub-based landrun stub is a true no-op (exit 0, no exec) -- previously harmless since Comparator's own internal COMPARATOR_LANDRUN use was never reached by any stub comparator, but now load-bearing since LANDRUN_PATH also wraps this script's OWN entire sandboxed invocation. Fixed by adding a write_landrun_stub() helper (skips flags to the first '--', execs the rest) and swapping it in at all four bindir setups (U, G, G3, V); lean4export's write_noop_stub usage is unaffected (never load-bearing). All 22 pre-existing cases + sibling check now PASS.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added write_landrun_stub() exec-forwarding test helper, replacing the no-op landrun stub at all bindir setups, since the outer landrun layer now wraps this script's whole invocation, not just Comparator's own internal (never-reached-by-stub) use)*

deviations.description: "A pre-flight failure path is reachable" criterion
deviations.reason: Full reachability proof (a stub git failing 'remote get-url' inside a populated .lake/packages/<dep>) requires the same stub-lake-populates-.lake/packages machinery Phase 4 is dedicated to building as its own pre-flight-probe regression case; building a redundant ad hoc version for Phase 3's own smoke check was judged not worth the added complexity given Phase 3's own Verification Tier is 'interface' (structural), not 'full'. Phase 4 delivers the actual reachability proof.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: deferred to Phase 4 — full pre-flight-probe reachability proof is Phase 4's own dedicated regression case)*
